Definition: Soul, life, self or living being — the whole person as a living, desiring, God-breathed creature.
BiblicalUsage: Nephesh does not mean a detachable ghost inside the body; Adam 'became a living nephesh.' The Psalms speak of the nephesh thirsting for God, blessing the Lord and finding rest in Him alone.
TheologicalSignificance: Nephesh teaches that God cares for the whole person — body, mind, longings and life itself. The soul that thirsts for God finds its anchor and satisfaction in Him.
